/.title: Pyarjan Thapa — Full-Stack Developer & Instructor
/.description: Portfolio of Pyarjan Thapa, a full-stack developer in Butwal, Nepal building web and mobile products with React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

/work.title: Work — Projects by Pyarjan Thapa
/work.description: Selected products by Pyarjan Thapa: Sarathi, MeroSanstha, BuildMyVita, Who Knows? and Vutungtung — SaaS platforms, developer tools and mobile apps.

/work/sarathi.title: Sarathi — Route-Based Ride-Sharing App | Pyarjan Thapa
/work/sarathi.description: Sarathi is a React Native ride-sharing app that matches riders travelling the same route, built with Expo, TypeScript and Supabase.

/work/merosanstha.title: MeroSanstha — Agency Client Onboarding SaaS | Pyarjan Thapa
/work/merosanstha.description: MeroSanstha is a SaaS platform for client onboarding, automated reminders and follow-ups, built for digital agencies with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

/work/buildmyvita.title: BuildMyVita — AI Resume Builder | Pyarjan Thapa
/work/buildmyvita.description: BuildMyVita is an AI-powered resume builder with a drag-and-drop editor, ATS-friendly templates and job-description matching, built with Next.js and PostgreSQL.

/work/whoknows.title: Who Knows? — Social Word Game | Pyarjan Thapa
/work/whoknows.description: Who Knows? is a multiplayer social word game built with React Native and Expo, where players race to guess words from cryptic clues.
/work/whoknows.imageAlt: Who Knows? social word game preview

/work/vutungtung.title: Vutungtung — Vehicle Rental Platform | Pyarjan Thapa
/work/vutungtung.description: Vutungtung is a vehicle rental platform for Nepal with GPS tracking, NID verification and digital contracts, built with React, Supabase and Tailwind CSS.
